description.short: ${TULIP_AGENT_NAME}: a 2lp agent you can talk to in Teams.
description.full: ${TULIP_AGENT_NAME} is a 2lp agent — a real Claude Code session, contained so that nothing it can be talked into reaches anything worth having. Message it directly, add it to a group chat, or add it to a team and @mention it in a channel. With the channel and chat message permissions granted at install it can also follow a conversation without being mentioned, and decide for itself when to speak. Voice notes, file attachments and reactions are not supported on Teams in this version.
